settings.title: ABOUT SIDESHOW.
settings.copy: Meet the studio and the artists behind the work.

settings.heading: A STUDIO IN THE HEART OF MURRAY.
settings.body:
Sideshow Productions brings tattoos, piercings, tooth gems, and teeth whitening together at 4973 South State Street in Murray, Utah.

Explore the crew's work and talk with your artist about the design, placement, and appointment you have in mind.

settings.heading: PART OF THE COMMUNITY.
settings.body: The studio has supported community fundraisers for causes including the Breast Cancer Research Foundation, Humane Society, Toys for Tots, and more. Follow Sideshow for upcoming events and ways to take part.

settings.heading: MEET THE CREW.
settings.body: From Jake and Rigo's tattoo work to Sonny's piercings and Megan's tooth gems and whitening, each member of the crew brings their own approach. Explore their portfolios and get to know your artist.

settings.name: Jake
settings.alt: Jake wearing blue gloves while tattooing a client's arm at Sideshow
settings.bio: Custom tattoo work, black and grey, lettering, and fine-line designs.
settings.hours: Tuesday & Friday: 4–10 pm. Wednesday, Thursday & Saturday: 3:30–10 pm. No Sunday or Monday appointments.

settings.name: Rigo
settings.alt: Blue and purple floral tattoo by Rigo
settings.bio: Custom tattoos and color work. Consultations in English or Spanish.
settings.hours: Tuesday–Saturday: 3–8 pm. No Sunday or Monday appointments.

settings.name: Sonny
settings.alt: Gold ear jewelry in piercing work by Sonny
settings.bio: Body piercings and jewelry. Contact Sonny about your placement and availability.
settings.deposit: 20% deposit. Jewelry included with new piercings.
settings.hours: Tuesday–Friday: 2–8 pm. Saturday: noon–8 pm. No Sunday or Monday appointments.

settings.name: Megan
settings.alt: Megan, Sideshow Productions tooth-gem and whitening artist
settings.bio: Tooth gems and teeth whitening. Explore gem options and whitening sessions.
settings.deposit: Additional gems $20 each. Heart/star $65. Fang $100. Whitening: single $89, double $120, triple $200. 20% deposit.
